---
title: "Execute Pipeline"
execute:
  eval: false
---

This page is the source of truth for the input-provenance and curation graph.
Render the Manual with the `emit` profile to materialize the scripts, or with
the `pipeline` profile to materialize them and run the graph after a complete
Manual render.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Input Boundary"}

Confirm that `stagecoach_manifest.yml` exists at the repository root and that
`data/inputs/` contains the staged input files required by the Curation page.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-source-r file="{{ emit.project_root }}/pipeline/_targets.R" title="Materialize The Input-Provenance Graph"}

```r
library(targets)
library(here)

source("pipeline/curate_biomarkers.R")

base_targets <- list(
  tar_target(
    stagecoach_manifest,
    here::here("stagecoach_manifest.yml"),
    format = "file"
  ),
  tar_target(
    raw_inputs,
    {
      input_dir <- here::here("data", "inputs")
      if (!dir.exists(input_dir)) {
        stop("Staged input directory is missing: ", input_dir)
      }

      inputs <- list.files(
        input_dir,
        recursive = TRUE,
        full.names = TRUE,
        include.dirs = FALSE,
        no.. = TRUE
      )
      if (!length(inputs)) {
        stop("No staged input files are available in: ", input_dir)
      }

      inputs
    },
    format = "file"
  )
)

c(base_targets, curation_targets())
```

:::

The generated `pipeline/_targets.R` is not hand-edited. To run it, use:

```sh
quarto render notebooks --profile pipeline
```
